title: the supervisor route chain was never validated at load
changelog:
### Fixed / 修复

- **A bad `roles.supervisor` chain loaded silently and failed every attempt at run time instead /
  写错的 `roles.supervisor` 链路能静默载入，代价是运行时每次都失败** —
  `src/settings.ts` kept the load-time route validation in a list that omitted `supervisor`, and
  that loop is the only check a stored chain gets. A supervisor route naming a provider this
  runtime does not have produced no error and no note, so the chain was accepted at load; the
  supervisor then ran after the verifier on every attempt (`src/script.ts`) and failed there,
  turning a task that could have been verified into a failed one. `supervisor` now sits between
  `verifier` and `synthesizer`, the documented execution order, so the same mistake fails the
  load with `roles.supervisor names provider "nope", which this runtime does not have` — which is
  the contract `src/config.ts` already stated for unusable chains. The same omission also
  silenced the empty-`maxInFlight` heads-up for the supervisor chain. /
  `src/settings.ts` 的载入期路由校验依赖一份角色清单，而清单漏了 `supervisor`——那个循环是存下来
  的链路唯一的检查。写错提供方的 supervisor 路由既不报错也不提示，链路照样载入；之后 supervisor
  在每次尝试里跟在 verifier 后面跑（`src/script.ts`），就在那里失败，把一个本来能通过验证的任务变成
  失败任务。现在 `supervisor` 排在 `verifier` 与 `synthesizer` 之间（文档写明的执行顺序），同样的
  错误会在载入时以 `roles.supervisor names provider "nope", which this runtime does not have`
  失败，也就是 `src/config.ts` 早已声明的约定。同一个漏项还让 supervisor 链路的「上限全空」提示
  从来不出现。

### Tests / 测试

- `test/config.spec.ts` (2 new cases, 36 in the file): an unknown provider in `roles.supervisor`
  must raise the same path-named error as every other role, and a 2+ route supervisor chain with
  every cap blank must raise the note — with the capped variant staying silent, which proves the
  note is role-driven. Red before the fix: `missing.errors[0]` was `undefined` (no error at all)
  and the note list was empty; green after. / `test/config.spec.ts`（新增 2 例，该文件共 36 例）：
  `roles.supervisor` 里写不存在的提供方必须和其它角色一样报出带路径的错误；supervisor 链路有 2 条
  以上路由且上限全空时必须给出提示，而填了上限就不提示——据此证明提示是角色驱动的。修复前红：
  `missing.errors[0]` 是 `undefined`（根本没有错误），提示列表为空；修复后绿。
report:
## Round 5 — the supervisor chain was never route-validated at load

- **Theme (P0, wrong behavior at load):** `src/settings.ts` held the load-time route
  validation's role list as `['planner', 'worker', 'verifier', 'synthesizer']`. `supervisor` is a
  real role (`src/config.ts` gives it a chain key; `src/script.ts` runs it after the verifier on
  every attempt when the chain is non-empty), so a `roles.supervisor` entry naming a provider the
  runtime does not have passed both loops with no error and no note — the chain was accepted at
  load and failed per attempt at run time, converting a task that could have been verified into a
  failed one. The same omission produced no empty-`maxInFlight` note for the supervisor chain.
  `CONFIRMED` by the red run: `validateRoutes(ctx, resolveConfig({roles:{supervisor:[{provider:'nope',model:'x'}]}}))`
  returned `{errors: [], notes: []}` before the change.
- **Change:** `supervisor` added to `ROLE_ORDER` between `verifier` and `synthesizer`, i.e. the
  documented execution order (break-down → do → check → supervise → wrap-up). Both consumers
  (`configured` collection at ~line 176 and the note loop at ~line 186) are order-sensitive only
  for message order, and no existing assertion depends on that order (the older tests assert with
  `errors[0]` on single-role configs and with `.some()`/`.includes()` on notes), so the placement
  only makes messages read like the run spends its calls. The comment above the list now states
  why a missing role is invisible instead of load-time failure.
- **Files:** `src/settings.ts`, `test/config.spec.ts`, `.rsi/evidence/round-005/`.
- **Evidence:** `.rsi/evidence/round-005/red.txt` (`npx vitest run test/config.spec.ts` before the
  fix — 2 failed / 34 passed: `missing.errors[0]` undefined and the note list empty),
  `.rsi/evidence/round-005/green.txt` (36/36 after), `.rsi/evidence/round-005/ci.txt`
  (`{{CI}}`), tag `{{TAG}}`.
- **Unverified:** `lib/` was not regenerated in this commit — the round's scope forbids touching
  it, so the committed `lib/settings.js` artifacts still carry the old three-role list until the
  release build runs `npm run build` (`NOT_RUN` this round; `npm run ci` did compile the new
  source through `tsc --noEmit` and the full suite, and the worktree's build output was discarded
  with `git checkout -- lib/`). No live installed-profile check of a real supervisor chain was run
  (`NOT_RUN` — the validation itself is a pure function covered by `test/config.spec.ts`).
- **Suggested version:** patch → `0.11.5`.
- **status:** OK

commit_message:
fix(config): validate the supervisor route chain at load (RSI round 5)

`ROLE_ORDER` in `src/settings.ts` omitted `supervisor`, and its two loops are
the only load-time validation a stored chain gets. A `roles.supervisor` entry
naming a provider this runtime does not have therefore returned no error and no
note: the bad chain was accepted at load and failed per attempt at run time,
where `script.ts` runs the supervisor after the verifier whenever the chain is
non-empty. That turns a task that could have been verified into a failed one,
which is the opposite of the contract `src/config.ts` states for unusable
chains. The same omission silenced the empty-`maxInFlight` heads-up for the
supervisor chain.

`supervisor` now sits between `verifier` and `synthesizer`, matching the
documented execution order (break-down → do → check → supervise → wrap-up).
Both consumers (`configured` collection and the note loop) are order-sensitive
only for message order, so the placement only makes messages read like the run.

Tests (test/config.spec.ts, existing assertions untouched):
- unknown provider in `roles.supervisor` -> `roles.supervisor names provider
  "nope", which this runtime does not have; known providers: p1`
- two supervisor routes with every cap blank -> note on `roles.supervisor`;
  filling one cap silences it, proving the note is role-driven.

Evidence: .rsi/evidence/round-005/red.txt (2 failed / 34 passed before the fix),
green.txt (36/36 after), ci.txt (npm run ci exit 0, 54 files / 983 tests).
lib/ is deliberately not regenerated in this commit; the release build rebuilds it.
